findings.message: The scope and the test_git.py criterion need squatch/git.py to decide HEAD-reachable first-parent ancestry and to read one squatch-ticket/squatch-reviewed-sha trailer pair. No existing Git method can do either. rev_parse only runs `rev-parse --verify`, and there is no rev-list, merge-base, or log/trailer operation. The only paths are a new public coroutine or a private `_run` probe from retro.py or __main__.py, which would bypass the public seam. A new public coroutine breaks test_git_conflict_seams_are_only_additions_and_old_rebase_still_aborts. That test asserts the public Git coroutines minus a fixed allowlist equal exactly {rebase_stop_at_conflict, conflicted_paths, rebase_continue}, and test_mergequeue.py is outside the fence. Section 20 fixes the escape-column paths as exact fences, so the author cannot add it.
